Let A(h,y)=catalog\(prefix(h)∪{y}), M=|A|, and draw 32 negatives independently with q(j|h,y)=1/M. Uncorrected candidate cross-entropy is −s_y+log(exp(s_y)+Σ_j c_j exp(s_j)), where c_j is sampled multiplicity. A negative appearing three times contributes three denominator terms and triple its single-occurrence gradient contribution at the same normalization; equivalently its aggregated logit is s_j+log 3. Deduplicating therefore changes the objective. With replacement, expected multiplicity is 32/M; inclusion probability is instead 1−(1−1/M)^32. [TensorFlow sampler documentation](https://www.tensorflow.org/api_docs/python/tf/random/log_uniform_candidate_sampler)

For this explicitly target-excluding proposal, an importance-sampling construction keeps the deterministically included positive unchanged and uses negative logits s_j−log(32q(j|h,y)). Its denominator estimates exp(s_y)+Σ_{j∈A}exp(s_j); retain duplicates. This denominator estimate is unbiased, but its logarithm and resulting loss/gradient generally are not. Uniform correction adds log(M/32) only to negatives, so it does not cancel against the positive. Conventional TensorFlow sampled softmax instead subtracts proposal expected-count logs from both true and sampled logits; its true count describes the underlying random sampler, not forced-positive inclusion. Here q(y|h,y)=0, so blindly applying −log q to the positive is invalid. [Sampling reference](https://www.tensorflow.org/extras/candidate_sampling.pdf)

Consequently, prefix exclusion removes historical alternatives from competition: correction cannot recover full-catalog softmax where proposal support is zero. The construction above targets a denominator over {y}∪A, retaining y even on repeat interactions; uncorrected cross-entropy targets sampled-candidate discrimination. Target exclusion prevents accidental hits. If sampling permits target hits, mask those negative slots; rejection/redrawing changes the proposal and requires conditional probabilities. [Accidental-hit handling](https://www.tensorflow.org/api_docs/python/tf/nn/sampled_softmax_loss)
